objectives.title: Duchess
objectives.prompt: If everybody minded their own business, the world would go round a deal faster. Does that apply to your secrets as well? You have read access to the Wonderland/duchess repository, a small Python package. The Duchess cares about the security of her credentials — but there must be some PyPI token left somewhere. Clone the repository, look beyond its current state, and recover the leaked PyPI upload token. Submit the token exactly as it appears.
hints: PyPI upload tokens start with the prefix pypi-.
Mistakes may have been made in the past: the current tip is not the whole story. Look at the repository's history (git log, git show, or a secret scanner such as gitleaks).
A file was committed once and removed later. Removing a secret from the latest commit does not remove it from history.
